Not a free audit

You've been offered a free audit before.

Probably this month.

You know what a free audit is. It's a sales call with a PDF stapled to it. Somebody runs your website through a tool, finds twelve things wrong, and every one of them happens to be something they sell.

This isn't that. Nothing in this report is a reason to hire us. It's a list of where your market is choosing someone else right now, with proof you can check yourself in about thirty seconds.

What's in it

We don't look at your marketing. We look at your market.

1Who shows up instead of you.

We search your service in your town the way a customer does. Google. The map. And now ChatGPT. We screenshot who gets named. If it isn't you, you'll see exactly who it is.

2Why customers pick the other guy.

We read what your customers say about you. Then we read what your competitors' customers say about them. In their words, not ours. Every market has three or four reasons people choose. You'll know which ones you're losing on.

3Whether anyone answers at 7pm.

We call. We fill out your quote form and time the reply. Then we do the same thing to your top three competitors. You'll see the stopwatch.

4What it's worth to you.

You give us three numbers. Your average job. How many quotes you send a month. How many you book. We'll show you what the gap is costing you. We'd rather be low and right.

5The three things to fix this week.

Not twelve. Three. In order. With the tool for each one, already built.

Then we get on the phone for thirty minutes and walk through it. That's the part people tell us was worth the money.

Who it's for

Any business that lives on local customers.

A roofer. A plastic surgeon. A law firm. A gutter company. A preschool. The names on the report change. The four places a sale breaks don't.
